title: Fantasism
description: The modpack is a collection of animation, visual and performance mods to just make minecraft look better.
body: **_Fantasism_** is a **Modrinth modpack** which refreshes and changes the **visual**, **performance** and **audiable** side of **Minecraft** whilst still being vanilla friendly. It **doesn't** use **shaders** but feel free to add anything you'd like and let me know if you have a suggestion. Oh and also,I can't find out how to make it so you have the resource packs and settings already preloaded when you start the game, I'll try to figure it out but **_PLEASE_** let me know if you find out and/or   if you find any major glitches.
